messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm validating the fallback compatibility matrix for smart routing by customer tier/region. We saw a couple of oddities when enterprise EU customers hit the quantized variant: tokenization differences + tool-calling parity. Can we triage?

maria: Where did the tokenization diffs show up? sample prompts or edge cases?

alex: Mostly emoji + CJK clusters and some markdown with inline code. Variant A (int8-quant) splits some tokens differently -> function-call arg alignment breaks in a few tests. Repro steps attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/compat-emoji

devon: Ugh. Are we 100% sure it's tokenization and not pre-token truncation? Context length handling differs between variants.

alex: Good point — I ran both. Variant A has 8192 logical tokens but tokenizer maps sequences differently so effective usable chars ~= 7900 for some utf8 combos. devon: that explains why tool args sometimes get split.

samir: From routing POV we need a safety gate: only route to a variant if the tokenization parity flag is true OR we have a post-tokenizer transformation that preserves function boundaries. Otherwise fallback to a variant with identical tokenizer.

maria: Proposal: add 3 checks in route-decider before committing to fallback: 1) TOKENIZER_PARITY, 2) TOOLCALL_SIGNATURE_PARITY, 3) EFFECTIVE_CONTEXT_MARGIN (e.g. require >=128 token headroom). If any fail, skip variant.

alex: Yes. Also instrument telemetry for "fallback.invoked" with reason codes: TOKENIZER_MISMATCH, TOOL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH, CONTEXT_OVERRUN so SRE/SMEs can monitor.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for route-decider v2 targeting eu-west (5%) — see rollout id rdo-2026-03-20-01

devon: UX ask: in Console rollout details, can we surface the fallback reason per request sample? e.g. a toggle in the request trace that says "fallback reason: TOKENIZER_MISMATCH" and links to the failing tokenization sample.

maria: Agreed. Also show the candidate variants and parity badges: Tokenizer: OK/Partial/No, ToolCall: OK/Partial/No, ContextMargin: number. That will help support when customers report subtle regressions.

alex: For the matrix itself, I'm thinking CSV-like rows for automation. Example:

```
variant,tokenizer_hash,toolcall_schema_hash,max_context,effective_margin,tokenizer_parity,toolcall_parity
redwood-quant-v2,sha256:aa11,sha256:bb22,8192,200,true,partial
redwood-fp16,sha256:aa11,sha256:cc33,8192,350,true,true
redwood-cpu,sha256:dd44,sha256:bb22,16384,120,false,partial
```

samir: Nice. We'll store that in the catalog as compatibility metadata and query it in route-decider.

devon: One more nuance: tool-calling parity "partial" needs behavioral rules. If schema hash mismatches but argument names identical, we might still allow but wrap with "arg-boundary-protector" to avoid split tokens. Needs runtime cost estimate.

maria: Can we run a small job to compute tokenizer_hash equality across models in our catalog? I'll own the job if someone sets the query in model-catalog.

alex: Assigning: maria -> tokenizer parity job + Console UI badge; devon -> arg-boundary-protector spec + perf estimate; samir -> route-decider gate + telemetry event schema. I'll draft a short RFC and add the matrix CSV to the model-catalog API.

maria: ETA for job: today EOD. I'll post a follow-up thread with initial diffs.

devon: I'll prototype arg-boundary-protector by tomorrow, but note it may add ~2-5ms per call depending on batch size.

samir: For quotas: ensure we don't accidentally double-bill when a request is routed then fallbacks mid-stream. Route-decider should mark a single canonical variant for billing and emit fallback events only for logging, not billing changes.

alex: Good catch. Billing model stays tied to initial assigned variant; fallback is transparent from billing POV. Add that to RFC.

ops-bot: incident-bot: small spike in fallback.invoked observed 03:14 UTC, correlated with eu-west canary. Investigating.

maria: Thanks. If that spike persists after parity job, we'll rollback canary.

alex: TL;DR action items: (1) maria run tokenizer parity job + Console badges, (2) devon spec and perf for arg-boundary-protector, (3) samir implement route-decider gates + telemetry schema, (4) alex draft RFC with CSV matrix and billing note. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
